name: 61704 · Bloomington, IL
findings: ZIP 61704 (Bloomington) has 145 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61704 (Bloomington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 61704 (Bloomington) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
